questions.q:
Consider the following statements about the state visit of South Korean President Lee Jae-myung to India in April 2026:
1. South Korea announced that it would join the Indo-Pacific Oceans Initiative and the International Solar Alliance.
2. The two countries signed an upgraded India-Korea CEPA during the visit.
3. India announced that it would join the Global Green Growth Institute.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: The two sides adopted a Joint Strategic Vision for the India-ROK Special Strategic Partnership, with cooperation in shipbuilding, shipping and maritime logistics, and launched an Economic Security Dialogue. On trade they only issued a joint declaration to resume negotiations on upgrading the CEPA, so no upgraded agreement was signed.
questions.s: PM India and Free Press Journal, 20 Apr 2026

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about India's bilateral engagements in April 2026:
1. During Austrian Chancellor Christian Stocker's visit, the two countries signed a Letter of Intent on military cooperation and set up a Joint Working Group on Counter Terrorism.
2. Bangladesh's Foreign Minister Khalilur Rahman made a three-day visit to New Delhi from 7 April, the first high-level political visit from Dhaka since the BNP-led government took office.
3. The India-Austria military Letter of Intent builds on the India-EU Free Trade Agreement signed on 27 January 2026.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: The Letter of Intent builds on the India-EU Defence and Security Partnership signed on 27 January 2026; the India-EU free trade negotiations were concluded the same day but the agreement itself was not signed. The Bangladesh visit came after Sheikh Hasina's ouster in August 2024.
questions.s: All India Radio, PM India and Swarajya, 7-16 Apr 2026

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about the Borrowers' Platform launched in April 2026:
1. It was launched by developing countries during the IMF-World Bank Spring Meetings in Washington, D.C.
2. The IMF serves as its secretariat.
3. It was agreed under the Sevilla Commitment of the Fourth International Conference on Financing for Development.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: It is the first-ever such platform and is member-state-led, with about 30 countries including India taking part in the launch. The secretariat is provided by UN Trade and Development (UNCTAD), not the IMF, which is the creditor-side institution the platform is meant to balance.
questions.s: Down To Earth and UNCTAD, 15 Apr 2026

questions.q: Which one of the following statements about the Artemis Accords, in the news in April 2026 when Jordan became the 63rd signatory, is correct?
o: They are a legally binding treaty negotiated under the UN Committee on the Peaceful Uses of Outer Space
They are a non-binding set of principles for civil space exploration launched in 2020 by NASA and the US Department of State
India was among the seven founding signatories of 2020
They were launched jointly by NASA and the European Space Agency to govern deep-space mining only
questions.e: The Accords were launched in 2020 with seven other founding members (Australia, Canada, Italy, Japan, Luxembourg, the UAE and the UK), and India signed them in 2023. They are political commitments and not a treaty, which distinguishes them from the Outer Space Treaty, 1967.
questions.s: NASA and SatellitePro, 23 Apr 2026

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about the US-Iran ceasefire of April 2026:
1. President Trump announced a two-week ceasefire on 8 April 2026, conditional on Iran reopening the Strait of Hormuz.
2. Pakistan was named as the principal mediator, and talks were held in Islamabad on 11 April.
3. The Islamabad talks led by US Vice President JD Vance ended with a comprehensive agreement.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: The talks, with Iran's delegation led by parliament speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf, ended after about 21 hours without an agreement. The US then announced a blockade of Iranian ports on 13 April, which is the backdrop to later clashes at sea and to the June Islamabad MoU.
questions.s: Tribune, IDSA, Apr 2026

questions.q: The Chagos Islands were in the news in April 2026 when the British government put on hold its deal to cede sovereignty over the archipelago. Which one of the following statements about the Chagos archipelago is correct?
o: It lies in the central Indian Ocean, and its largest island, Diego Garcia, hosts a US military base
It lies in the Mozambique Channel between Madagascar and the African mainland
It is an Indian-administered archipelago in the Bay of Bengal near the Andaman and Nicobar Islands
It lies in the Arabian Sea off the coast of Oman, and Diego Garcia hosts a joint Indian and French base
questions.e: The archipelago has been a UK overseas territory since 1965 and Mauritius has long claimed sovereignty. Its location in the central Indian Ocean, south of the Maldives, is why Diego Garcia is strategically important for the United States.
questions.s: Vajiram & Ravi, 12 Apr 2026

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about developments in Lebanon in April 2026:
1. Israel announced a 'Yellow Line' buffer zone in southern Lebanon extending up to the Litani River during a ceasefire that began on 16 April 2026.
2. India condemned the killing of Indonesian peacekeepers of UNIFIL in south Lebanon without naming Israel.
3. UNIFIL was established by the UN General Assembly in 1978.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: UNIFIL, the United Nations Interim Force in Lebanon, was established by the UN Security Council in March 1978 and its mandate was strengthened in 2006; India is among its troop-contributing countries. The 'Yellow Line' term first emerged during the Gaza war in October 2025 as a boundary between Israeli-controlled and Palestinian-held areas.
questions.s: Vajiram & Ravi, 3-16 Apr 2026

questions.q: The Bnei Menashe community, whose members were airlifted from Mizoram and Manipur to Israel in April 2026 under 'Operation Wings of Dawn', is drawn mainly from which tribes?
o: Naga and Meitei tribes, claiming descent from the tribe of Judah
Mizo and Kuki tribes, claiming descent from the tribe of Manasseh
Garo and Khasi tribes, claiming descent from the tribe of Levi
Bodo and Karbi tribes, claiming descent from the tribe of Benjamin
questions.e: The Bnei Menashe claim descent from Manasseh, one of the 'ten lost tribes of Israel', and Israel's Chief Rabbinate recognised them in 2005. The Israeli government approved funding in November 2025 to relocate members, and this was the first batch supported by it.
questions.s: Vajiram & Ravi, 26 Apr 2026

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about India's BRICS chairship in 2026:
1. India hosted the BRICS Foreign Ministers' Meeting at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi, on 14-15 May 2026, chaired by External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar.
2. The BRICS chairship rotates among members in the alphabetical order of their country names.
3. 2026 is India's fourth BRICS chairship, after 2012, 2016 and 2021.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: The chairship rotates in the order of the acronym, B-R-I-C-S, not alphabetically. The 2026 theme is 'Building for Resilience, Innovation, Cooperation and Sustainability', and the foreign ministers' meeting, attended by Russia's Lavrov and Iran's Araghchi among others, reported no formal joint statement.
questions.s: All India Radio and Punjab Kesari, 14-15 May 2026
questions.h: B-R-I-C-S: the chair moves in acronym order

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about the Quad Foreign Ministers' Meeting held in New Delhi on 26 May 2026:
1. It was attended by US Secretary of State Marco Rubio and the foreign ministers of Japan and Australia.
2. The ministers announced a Critical Minerals Initiative to mobilise up to USD 20 billion.
3. The first project under the maritime surveillance and port-infrastructure plan is a port in Sri Lanka.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: The first project is a port in Fiji, not Sri Lanka. The meeting also announced an Indo-Pacific Energy Security initiative, and Australia is to take over the Quad chair from India. The Quad groups India, the United States, Japan and Australia.
questions.s: Business Standard, The Week and All India Radio, 26 May 2026

questions.q:
Consider the following pairs about Prime Minister Modi's Europe tour in May 2026 (Country : Upgraded relationship):
1. The Netherlands : Strategic Partnership
2. Italy : Green Strategic Partnership
3. Norway : Green Strategic Partnership
4. Sweden : Special Strategic Partnership
How many of the above pairs are correctly matched?
questions.e: Pairs 1 and 3 are correct. Italy was upgraded to a Special Strategic Partnership, while Sweden's ties became a Strategic Partnership, with a joint action plan for 2026-2030. The tour, after a stopover in Abu Dhabi, also produced a Nordic summit format upgrade to a Green Technology and Innovation Strategic Partnership.
questions.s: The Statesman, Tribune and ANSA, 17-20 May 2026

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about the 3rd India-Nordic Summit:
1. It was held in Oslo on 19 May 2026, hosted by Norwegian Prime Minister Jonas Gahr Store.
2. Estonia is one of the five Nordic countries that took part.
3. The earlier summits were held in Stockholm (2018) and Copenhagen (2022).
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: The five Nordic countries are Denmark, Finland, Iceland, Norway and Sweden; the Baltic state Estonia is not Nordic. The summit elevated ties to a 'Green Technology and Innovation Strategic Partnership', and Finland will host the 4th summit.
questions.s: The Statesman and Tribune, 19 May 2026

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about the visit of Vietnam's General Secretary and President To Lam to India in May 2026:
1. India and Vietnam upgraded their ties to an 'Enhanced Comprehensive Strategic Partnership'.
2. Vietnam joined the Indo-Pacific Oceans Initiative.
3. An Indian liaison officer will be posted at the Information Fusion Centre-Indian Ocean Region in Mumbai.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: The Information Fusion Centre-IOR is located in Gurugram, so the liaison officer will be posted there. The two sides set a bilateral trade target of USD 25 billion by 2030 and noted the tenth anniversary of the Comprehensive Strategic Partnership of 2016.
questions.s: Diplomatist and PM India, 6 May 2026

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about the 35th meeting of the Working Mechanism for Consultation and Coordination on India-China Border Affairs:
1. It was held in Beijing on 27 May 2026.
2. Both sides agreed to prepare for the next Special Representatives' talks, to be held in China.
3. India's delegation was led by the National Security Adviser.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: India was represented by Joint Secretary (East Asia) Sujit Ghosh. The WMCC is a diplomatic-level mechanism, while the Special Representatives' talks are held at the level of India's NSA Ajit Doval and China's foreign minister. India also pressed for an early meeting of the Expert Level Mechanism on trans-border rivers.
questions.s: All India Radio and Chinese MFA, 27 May 2026

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about Prime Minister Modi's brief visit to Abu Dhabi on 15 May 2026 and related developments:
1. India and the UAE signed an energy pact that includes potential storage of crude oil at Fujairah as part of India's strategic petroleum reserve.
2. Chabahar Port lies in Iran's Sistan-Baluchestan province on the Gulf of Oman and is a key node of the International North-South Transport Corridor.
3. The US sanctions waiver for Chabahar Port was extended for a further year in April 2026.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: The waiver expired in April 2026, and in May Iran urged India to keep investing. India signed a 10-year agreement in 2024 for India Ports Global Limited to operate the Shahid Beheshti terminal. During the Abu Dhabi stopover India and the UAE also signed a strategic defence cooperation framework.
questions.s: Al Jazeera and Bloomberg, 15-16 May 2026

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about the Indian Ocean region:
1. The 10th Indian Ocean Dialogue, held in New Delhi on 7-8 May 2026, is a Track 1.5 initiative of the Indian Ocean Rim Association organised with the Indian Council of World Affairs.
2. India is the chair of the Indian Ocean Rim Association for 2025-27.
3. The IORA Secretariat is located in Colombo.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: The IORA Secretariat is in Ebene, Mauritius. India's SAGAR vision of 2015 was extended to MAHASAGAR in 2025. At the Shangri-La Dialogue in Singapore on 30 May, US Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth called India a 'powerful' and 'modernising' military power and a key pillar of Indo-Pacific stability.
questions.s: IORA and Onmanorama, 8 May 2026

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about the Trump-Xi summit in Beijing in May 2026:
1. The summit produced no joint communique.
2. The two sides created a US-China Board of Trade and a Board of Investment.
3. China committed to buy 200 Airbus passenger aircraft.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: China committed to buy 200 Boeing passenger aircraft. The leaders agreed to build 'constructive strategic stability' and to extend the suspension of announced tariffs, but there was no progress on Taiwan and no joint action on the US-Iran war, only an agreement to consult on oil flows through the Strait of Hormuz.
questions.s: Bloomberg and East Asia Forum, 15 May 2026

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about the attack on the tanker MT Settebello on 10 June 2026:
1. The Palau-flagged tanker was struck by a US aircraft in the Gulf of Oman, and three Indian seafarers were killed.
2. The US military said it was enforcing its blockade of Iranian ports.
3. The Gulf of Oman lies between the Persian Gulf and the Red Sea.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: The Gulf of Oman connects the Arabian Sea with the Strait of Hormuz and so with the Persian Gulf; it is not near the Red Sea. India's foreign ministry summoned a senior US diplomat and lodged a strong protest, and Shipping Minister Sarbananda Sonowal ordered the rapid return of the rescued crew and the remains.
questions.s: Al Jazeera, ETV Bharat and WION, 10-11 Jun 2026

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about the 'Islamabad Memorandum of Understanding' signed in June 2026:
1. It is a 14-point MoU between the United States and Iran, mediated by Pakistan, to end hostilities and reopen the Strait of Hormuz.
2. It provides a negotiating window of up to 60 days for a final deal on sanctions and Iran's nuclear programme.
3. It was mediated by Oman and Switzerland.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: Pakistan mediated, with Qatar also reported as a mediator, and the MoU was signed on 17 June 2026 by President Trump and Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian, reportedly virtually. It also addressed the US naval blockade and frozen assets. India welcomed the MoU and the reopening of Hormuz.
questions.s: Al Jazeera, Arab News and Drishti IAS, 17 Jun 2026

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about the G7 Leaders' Summit of June 2026:
1. It was hosted by France at Evian-les-Bains.
2. India attended as a full member of the G7.
3. Prime Minister Modi told the outreach session that the war in West Asia would disrupt fuel, fertiliser and food supply chains.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: India is not a G7 member and attends as an outreach invitee; the G7 comprises Canada, France, Germany, Italy, Japan, the UK and the US, with the EU as a non-enumerated member. Modi also pitched the IMPACT connectivity initiative and a Global South support fund.
questions.s: News Arena India and All India Radio, 16-17 Jun 2026

questions.q:
Statement-I: On 16 June 2026 the US Department of War restored the name 'US Pacific Command' for the command that had been called US Indo-Pacific Command.
Statement-II: The name 'Indo-Pacific Command' had been adopted in May 2018 and was widely seen as recognising India's role in the region.
o: Both Statement-I and Statement-II are correct and Statement-II explains Statement-I
Both Statement-I and Statement-II are correct and Statement-II does not explain Statement-I
Statement-I is correct but Statement-II is incorrect
Statement-I is incorrect but Statement-II is correct
questions.e: Both statements are correct, but the 2018 history does not explain why the name was reverted in 2026. The Pentagon said the change honours the command's historical roots and does not alter its mission or area of responsibility.
questions.s: Defense News and Stars and Stripes, 16 Jun 2026

questions.q:
Consider the following statements:
1. The first batch of the 2026 Kailash Mansarovar Yatra was flagged off from New Delhi on 13 June 2026, after a computerised draw conducted by External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar.
2. The Yatra is organised by the Ministry of Tourism.
3. Nepal claims Kalapani, Lipulekh and Limpiyadhura on the basis of the 1816 Treaty of Sugauli, with the Kali river as the boundary.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: The Yatra is organised by the Ministry of External Affairs, and the first 2026 batch travelled via Nathu La. Nepal's Prime Minister Balendra Shah's early-June remark on the boundary was later clarified by Nepal's Foreign Ministry as referring to areas such as Dasgaja.
questions.s: All India Radio, IANS and Scroll, Jun 2026

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about the 16th BRICS National Security Advisers' Meeting held in New Delhi on 22-23 June 2026:
1. It was chaired by NSA Ajit Doval.
2. It focused chiefly on trade and tariff coordination among members.
3. NSA Doval met Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi on the sidelines of the meeting.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: The theme was non-traditional security challenges such as cybersecurity, terrorism and AI governance, and the meeting was a preparatory step for the BRICS leaders' summit to be held in India later in 2026. The Ministry of External Affairs described the Doval-Wang meeting as 'forward looking', citing progress toward gradual normalisation of India-China ties.
questions.s: Drishti IAS and Superkalam, 22 Jun 2026

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about the 'BRICS Indore Declaration' adopted at the 16th BRICS Agriculture Ministers' Meeting in June 2026:
1. It backs a Global Forum on Farmers' Rights in Seed Systems coordinated by the Protection of Plant Varieties and Farmers' Rights Authority.
2. It was adopted at the meeting held in Indore, Madhya Pradesh, under India's chairship.
3. It announces a BRICS Grain Exchange that is already operational.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: The Grain Exchange is only proposed in the declaration. The declaration also covers a BRICS AGRIN platform on seeds and inputs and networks on agroecology and digital agriculture.
questions.s: Agriculture Post and Vision IAS, 13 Jun 2026

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about Prime Minister Modi's visit to Seychelles in June 2026:
1. He was the Guest of Honour at the Golden Jubilee celebrations of Seychelles' National Day.
2. The visit was meant to advance India's MAHASAGAR vision, which succeeded the SAGAR doctrine.
3. MAHASAGAR was announced by India in 2015.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: The SAGAR (Security and Growth for All in the Region) vision dates from 2015 and was extended as MAHASAGAR (Mutual and Holistic Advancement for Security and Growth Across Regions) in 2025. Seychelles' President is Patrick Herminie and the three-day visit ran from 27 June.
questions.s: PM India and All India Radio, 27 Jun 2026
